title: List every SQL Server database
description: Show the full list of databases on a SQL Server instance with their size, state and recovery model.

windowsCommandTemplate.name: Invoke-Sqlcmd
windowsCommandTemplate.commandPattern: Invoke-Sqlcmd -ServerInstance '{serverInstance}' -Query "SELECT name AS DatabaseName, database_id AS ID, state_desc AS State, recovery_model_desc AS RecoveryModel, (SELECT SUM(size)*8/1024 FROM sys.master_files WHERE database_id = d.database_id) AS SizeMB FROM sys.databases d ORDER BY name" | Format-Table -AutoSize

parameters.name: serverInstance
parameters.label: SQL Server instance
parameters.description: SQL Server instance name (e.g. localhost, SERVER\INSTANCE)

examples.description: Simple list of the databases and their state
Detailed list on a named instance

examples.command: Invoke-Sqlcmd -ServerInstance 'localhost\SQLEXPRESS' -Query "SELECT name AS DatabaseName, database_id AS ID, state_desc AS State, recovery_model_desc AS RecoveryModel, (SELECT SUM(size)*8/1024 FROM sys.master_files WHERE database_id = d.database_id) AS SizeMB FROM sys.databases d ORDER BY name" | Format-Table -AutoSize
examples.description: Show the full list of databases on a SQL Server instance with their size, state and recovery model.

notes: Requires the SqlServer PowerShell module or sqlcmd.exe. Read permission on sys.databases is required.

fr.title: Lister toutes les bases de données SQL Server
fr.description: Affiche la liste complète de toutes les bases de données sur une instance SQL Server avec leur taille, état et mode de récupération.
fr.notes: Nécessite le module SqlServer PowerShell ou sqlcmd.exe. Privilèges de lecture requis sur sys.databases.
